title: Har Chhatravritti: Haryana Scholarship Apply Online
meta_description: Har Chhatravritti is Haryana's online scholarship for SC and BC post matric students. Apply at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in using your Family ID.

hero.one_liner: Har Chhatravritti is Haryana's centralised scholarship portal. SC, BC, and OBC students apply with their PPP Family ID at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in.

what_is_it: Har Chhatravritti is the centralized online scholarship portal of the Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana, available at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in. The portal brings together multiple state and centrally-sponsored scholarship schemes for Scheduled Caste, Backward Class, and other eligible categories of students in Haryana colleges.

The Post Matric Scholarship for SC students is the flagship scheme on the portal, jointly funded by the state and central government. It covers full tuition fee reimbursement, a yearly academic allowance based on course group, and a freeship card that allows SC students to enrol in college without paying fees upfront.

how_to_apply.title: Open the portal and click Student Registration
how_to_apply.description: Open your browser and go to harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in. If you are a new applicant, click the Student Registration link at the top of the page. Existing applicants from a previous academic year can use the User Login button directly and skip the registration steps.

how_to_apply.title: Enter your Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID and generate OTP
how_to_apply.description: On the registration page, type your 8-digit Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID into the search box. A list of all members registered under that Family ID will appear on screen. Select your name from the list and click Generate OTP to receive a one-time password on the mobile number linked to your Family ID.

how_to_apply.title: Verify OTP and review auto-filled details
how_to_apply.description: Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click Verify OTP to proceed. The registration form will automatically fill in your name, category, date of birth, income, and address from the PPP database. Cross-check all auto-filled details carefully, and if any information is incorrect, update your Family ID at meraparivar.haryana.gov.in before continuing.

how_to_apply.title: Select your college and create a login password
how_to_apply.description: From the department and college dropdown menus, select the institution where you are currently enrolled. Use the Know Your AISHE feature on the portal if you are unsure of your college code, as an incorrect AISHE entry is a common cause of application delay. Create a strong login password and click Register to complete the registration step.

how_to_apply.title: Login and fill in the scholarship application form
how_to_apply.description: Click the User Login link, enter your mobile number or email and password, and navigate to the scholarship application section. Enter your course name, roll number, current year of study, and eligibility group from Group 1 to Group 4 based on your course type. Upload all required documents including Aadhaar card, caste certificate, domicile certificate, income certificate, fee receipt, and previous year mark sheet.

how_to_apply.title: Submit the application and note your reference number
how_to_apply.description: Review all entered details carefully before clicking the Apply button to submit your scholarship application. The portal will generate an application reference number immediately after submission. Note this reference number and keep it safe as it is required for tracking your application status and for raising any grievance if the application is delayed or rejected.

how_to_apply.title: Track your application status at every stage
how_to_apply.description: Login to the portal and click Track Application to see the current stage of your scholarship file. The tracker shows whether the application is pending at the college principal level, at the district office, or has been approved and sent for payment processing. If there is no movement after two weeks, contact your college principal to check whether the college verification has been done.

how_to_apply.title: Verify credit of tuition fee and academic allowance
how_to_apply.description: After final approval, the compulsory non-refundable fees including tuition are transferred directly to your institution's account, and the academic allowance component is credited to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Ensure your bank account has Aadhaar seeding completed before applying to avoid disbursement delays. If you received a freeship card, inform the institution to collect the fees within seven working days of the scholarship credit.

ministry: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Haryana

extra_sections.heading: What Har Chhatravritti Is
content: Har Chhatravritti was launched to improve the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC and BC students in higher education by removing the financial barrier of upfront fee payment. Any eligible SC or BC student who has not yet applied is missing financial support that directly covers their institutional fee obligations.

To be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship for SC students, the applicant must be a permanent resident and domicile of Haryana. The annual income of the parents or guardian from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 as reported in the Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID.

The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste as recognised in Haryana and must be studying in a government, government-aided, or self-financing college recognised by the state. The student must maintain an attendance of at least 75 percent throughout the academic year for the scholarship to continue.

The Post Matric Scholarship covers a wide range of institutions including government universities, UGC-recognised colleges, deemed universities, and private professional institutions affiliated with state or central universities. Students from Class 11 onwards up to the post-doctoral level are eligible to apply through the portal.

Har Chhatravritti also accepts students enrolled in courses at institutions of national importance such as IITs, NITs, and central universities, provided the student meets the Haryana domicile, category, and income criteria. Applications from students at these institutions follow the same process on the portal.

extra_sections.heading: Who Is Eligible
content: The scholarship has two main financial components: full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees including tuition fees, and an academic allowance that varies by course group and hostel status. Both components are disbursed to the student's bank account or the institution after the application is verified and approved.

Course groups for the SC academic allowance are divided into four categories. Group 1 covers degree and postgraduate level professional courses such as MBBS, B.Tech, LLB, and MBA, where hostellers receive Rs 13,500 per year and day scholars receive Rs 7,000 per year.

extra_sections.title: One Portal, Many Scholarships
extra_sections.content:
Har Chhatravritti is the single centralised portal of Haryana's Directorate of Higher Education. It hosts post-matric, merit, and category-based scholarships.

You register once with your PPP Family ID, and your eligibility is checked from PPP data. There is no fee to apply.

extra_sections.heading: Who Is Eligible More
content: Group 2 of the academic allowance covers other professional courses leading to a degree, diploma, or certificate, where hostellers receive Rs 9,500 per year and day scholars Rs 6,500 per year. Group 3 covers graduate and postgraduate courses not in Groups 1 or 2, with hostellers getting Rs 6,000 and day scholars Rs 3,000 per year.

Group 4 covers all post-matriculation non-degree courses, which are courses at the level of Class 11 and 12 or equivalent diploma programmes, where hostellers receive Rs 4,000 per year and day scholars receive Rs 2,500 per year. Students with disabilities receive an additional 10 percent on top of the applicable group allowance.

The scholarship plays a critical role in preventing dropouts among SC and BC students at the post-secondary level, where tuition and hostel fees can be a significant financial burden for households near the income threshold. The freeship card and direct benefit transfer together ensure that no eligible student needs to arrange fees personally before starting their course.

extra_sections.heading: The Role of the PPP Family ID
content: The scholarship is payable for ten months in an academic year. Students who are not promoted to the next class or level at the end of the year lose their scholarship for that year, and the award is never extended beyond the standard duration of the course.

The Freeship Card is an important feature of the Har Chhatravritti system that allows eligible students to register at a college without paying fees at the time of admission. The institution accepts this card as a formal commitment from the state government that the scholarship amount will be transferred to the student's account within seven working days.

extra_sections.heading: The Role of the PPP Family ID More
content: To obtain a Freeship Card, students must register on the portal before the admission date and provide their Aadhaar number, intended course details, and a signed undertaking committing to pay fees within seven working days of receiving the scholarship. The freeship registration window remains open throughout the year on the portal.

The Post Matric Scholarship for BC and OBC students is a centrally-sponsored scheme that also runs through the Har Chhatravritti portal. BC and OBC students receive tuition fee reimbursement and a maintenance allowance as per central scheme norms applicable to other backward class students.

All components of the Har Chhatravritti scholarship are disbursed through the Direct Benefit Transfer system into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of students or directly to the institution's account for the tuition component. The PPP-integrated application process and DBT payment together make the scheme one of the most efficiently administered scholarship programmes in Haryana.

extra_sections.title: Your Family ID Drives Eligibility
extra_sections.desc:
You register on the portal using your PPP Family ID, and your income and category are fetched from it. A wrong PPP income can block your scholarship.

Check and fix your PPP details before you apply, so the fetched data matches your real situation.

extra_sections.heading: How to Register and Apply
content: For BC students, the income limit of parents or guardians is Rs 2,50,000 per year and the student must be a Haryana domicile belonging to a Backward Class recognised in the state. Attendance of at least 75 percent is mandatory for BC scholarship beneficiaries just as it is for SC students.

The centrally-sponsored scheme for OBC, EBC (Economically Backward Class), and Denotified Tribe (DNT) students follows the national post-matric scholarship guidelines as revised by the Government of India. The Har Chhatravritti portal coordinates data collection, verification, and disbursement for all these categories in one platform.

Beyond the SC and BC post-matric scholarships, the portal also manages the Consolidated Stipend Scheme for SC students and the Free Books for SC Scheme, both available only at government colleges. These two schemes require a minimum 60 percent attendance and are not subject to any income limit.

The State Merit Scholarship for UG Girls and the Haryana State Meritorious Incentives Scheme are also hosted on the portal and are open to students of any category who meet the merit criteria. The Lower Income Group Scheme provides support to students of any category whose family income is Rs 12,000 or less per year.

extra_sections.heading: The One-Time Registration Step
content: A student can apply for only one scholarship at a time under the Har Chhatravritti portal rules. If a student is receiving any other scholarship or stipend from any source simultaneously, they must choose the more beneficial option and formally notify the institution and the scholarship department.

Application for the Har Chhatravritti scholarship is done entirely online at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in at no cost. The process begins with student registration using the Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID, which auto-fills name, address, income, and category data without any manual entry.

The PPP integration in Har Chhatravritti significantly reduces paperwork because income and demographic data is pulled directly from the household Family ID database. Students whose Family ID at meraparivar.haryana.gov.in shows the correct category and income data will complete the application process with minimal document uploading.

After registering, the student selects their department and college from the portal list, sets a login password, and submits the application with course, roll number, and eligibility group. The system validates the information against the PPP database and flags any discrepancies for correction before final submission.

extra_sections.heading: Documents and Attendance
content: The scholarship application must be submitted before the annual deadline, which is typically around February 28 or March 31 of the academic year. Students should not wait until the last few days as high portal traffic near the deadline can cause technical delays that prevent timely submission.

Documents that must be uploaded at the time of application include the Aadhaar card, photograph, signature, income certificate, Haryana domicile certificate, caste certificate, Class 10 and 12 mark sheets and certificates, and the fee receipt for the current academic year. First-year students are not required to upload a last exam passed certificate from the current college.

A BPL certificate must be submitted if the student is from a below poverty line household, and a father's death certificate must be provided where it is relevant to the applicant's eligibility. All uploaded documents must be legible, current, and in the format accepted by the portal.

After application submission, the file is forwarded to the college principal for verification and then to the district authority for final approval. Students can track the real-time status of their scholarship application at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in by clicking the Track Application option on the portal home page.

extra_sections.title: Watch the Last Date
extra_sections.content:
The scholarship window opens and closes each year, often from mid-year to around January. Applications after the last date are not accepted for that cycle.

Apply early, and once submitted you usually cannot edit the form. Contact the helpline 7419800562 to 65 if you hit an issue.

extra_sections.heading: Tracking Your Application
content: Once the application is approved, the tuition fee component is transferred directly to the institution and the academic allowance is credited to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account. Any mismatch between the bank account and Aadhaar details will delay disbursement, so students must verify their account seeding before applying.

Scholarship renewal for the second and subsequent years of the same course is subject to submission of the annual progress report from the college and maintenance of the prescribed attendance. Students must ensure their college head submits the progress report on the portal before the renewal deadline each year.

A student who changes their course midway is generally not permitted to continue the scholarship under the new course. The scholarship is course-specific, and a change in department or discipline typically requires a fresh application evaluated under the applicable group for the new subject.

Students pursuing courses through correspondence or online distance education are eligible for fee reimbursement but will not receive the academic allowance component. Only students physically attending an institution qualify for the annual academic allowance addition to their scholarship amount.

extra_sections.text: Har Chhatravritti links your PPP Family ID to scholarship eligibility, making income verification instant and freeing SC and BC students from arranging college fees before financial support arrives in their account.

extra_sections.heading: Scholarships for Students Studying Outside Haryana
content: Students pursuing CA, ICWA, CS, or ICFA professional examinations are treated as day scholars for calculating the academic allowance, regardless of their physical accommodation arrangement. These students fall under Group 2 or Group 3 depending on the classification of the specific professional course.

Har Chhatravritti has a dedicated mobile application available on the Google Play Store under the name Har Chhatravratti. Students can use the app to register, apply, upload documents, and track application status from their smartphones without needing a desktop browser.

Grievances related to scholarship delays, rejection, or payment failures can be registered at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/Grievance and tracked through the portal. Students should have their application reference number ready before submitting a grievance as it is mandatory for the system to match the complaint to the correct record.

The Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana, oversees the Har Chhatravritti system and can be contacted by email at cru-sec.he@hry.gov.in for escalation of unresolved issues. The office is located at Shiksha Sadan, Sector 5, Panchkula, Haryana 134105.

extra_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection
content: Students who are domiciled in Haryana but hold an SC or BC certificate from another state are not eligible for the Haryana Post Matric Scholarship. Both the Haryana domicile certificate and the Haryana state-issued category certificate are mandatory for the application to be accepted.

All children of the same parent or guardian are individually eligible to apply for the scholarship if each child independently meets the eligibility criteria. The scheme does not limit scholarship awards to a single child per household, unlike some other state welfare programmes.

The Know Your AISHE feature on the portal helps students find the correct AISHE code for their institution before filling the application form. Entering an incorrect AISHE code is one of the most common reasons for application delay, and using this tool in advance prevents the error.

Students who have already paid their fees for the current semester can still apply for the scholarship, and the reimbursement will be credited to their account after approval. The scholarship is not restricted to students who registered via the freeship card route at the time of admission.

faqs.question: What is Har Chhatravritti in Haryana?
faqs.answer: Har Chhatravritti is the centralized online scholarship portal at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in operated by the Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana. It provides the Post Matric Scholarship for SC and BC students along with several other schemes including the Consolidated Stipend for SC, Free Books for SC, State Merit Scholarship for UG Girls, and the Lower Income Group Scheme.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the post matric scholarship Haryana for SC students?
faqs.answer: SC students who are Haryana domiciles, belong to a Scheduled Caste recognised in Haryana, are studying in a government or government-aided or SFC college, have family income below Rs 2,50,000 per year in the PPP, and maintain at least 75 percent attendance are eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship.

faqs.question: What is the academic allowance under Har Chhatravritti SC scholarship?
faqs.answer: The academic allowance for SC students ranges from Rs 2,500 per year for day scholars in Group 4 non-degree courses to Rs 13,500 per year for hostellers in Group 1 professional courses like MBBS or B.Tech. Students with disabilities get 10 percent extra on the applicable group allowance.

faqs.question: How do I apply for Har Chhatravritti scholarship?
faqs.answer:
Visit harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in and click Student Registration. Enter your Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID, verify via OTP, select your college, and set a password.

Then login and fill in the scholarship application with your course details and upload required documents.

faqs.question: What is the Freeship Card under Har Chhatravritti?
faqs.answer: The Freeship Card allows eligible SC and BC students to enrol in college without paying fees at the time of admission. The student must register for the card on the portal before admission and commit to paying the fees within seven working days of receiving the scholarship amount in their bank account.

faqs.question: What documents are required for Har Chhatravritti scholarship application?
faqs.answer: Required documents include Aadhaar card, photograph, signature, income certificate, Haryana domicile certificate, caste certificate, Class 10 and 12 certificates, Parivar Pehchan Patra, fee receipt, and last exam passed certificate (except for first-year students). BPL certificate and father's death certificate are needed where applicable.

faqs.question: What is the income limit for BC post matric scholarship Haryana?
faqs.answer: The income limit for BC or OBC students applying for the Post Matric Scholarship through Har Chhatravritti is Rs 2,50,000 per year from all sources of the parents or guardians. This limit is verified through the Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID data.

faqs.question: Can a student hold both Har Chhatravritti and another scholarship?
faqs.answer: No. Students receiving any other scholarship or stipend simultaneously must choose only one, selecting the more beneficial option. They must inform the institution and the scholarship authority about their choice, and no payment will be made under Har Chhatravritti from the date the student accepts the other scholarship.

faqs.question: How do I track my Har Chhatravritti scholarship application?
faqs.answer:
Login at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in and click Track Application. The portal shows the current stage of your application, including whether it is pending with the college principal, the district office, or has been approved.

You can also raise a grievance at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/Grievance if there is no movement.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app for Har Chhatravritti?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The Har Chhatravratti mobile app is available on the Google Play Store for Android devices.

Students can register, apply for scholarship, upload documents, and track application status using the mobile app.

faqs.question: What happens to the scholarship if a student fails or does not get promoted?
faqs.answer: No scholarship will be awarded for the year in which the student fails to get promoted to the next class or level. The scholarship is renewed for the next year only on receipt of a progress report confirming promotion and continued study at the institution.

faqs.question: Is Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) mandatory for Har Chhatravritti?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The application process at harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in requires the student's 8-digit Parivar Pehchan Patra Family ID for registration.

Income, category, and address data is auto-filled from the PPP, so students must ensure their Family ID is updated at meraparivar.haryana.gov.in before applying.
